messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to enable rwdx-1.1 in the model catalog during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window tomorrow. Canary rollout: 5% global -> 25% -> 100%. Need confirmation on fallback ordering and pinning behavior.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for rwdx-1.1 -> 5% traffic. (deploy id: dpl_8792)

maya: +1 on starting canary. My recommended fallback order: [rwdx-1.1, rwdx-1.0, gpt-open-3b-quant]. If latency or regen errors >2% in a region, revert that region to rwdx-1.0.

sri: Agree, but be careful with us-west GPUs — memory pressure is higher. Propose lowering us-west canary to 2% and bump eu-west to 8%.

jordan: Note: rwdx-1.1 introduces a new kv-cache encoding. Long-running pinned sessions should stay on their original variant. We need a pinning policy in the catalog so session affinity doesn't silently migrate.

alex: Good catch. Proposed rollout config: 
```
{"canary": {"global": "5%", "us-west": "2%", "eu-west": "8%"}, "fallback_order": ["rwdx-1.1","rwdx-1.0","gpt-open-3b-quant"], "pinning_policy": "session_pinned_to_original_version"}
```

maya: :thumbsup: I can bake that into the catalog entry and the release notes.

sri: I'll attach alerts: p50 latency +15% or regen error rate >1.5% for 10m should trigger immediate review.

ops-bot: Alert rule created: rwdx-1.1_canary_latency. Threshold: p50 +15% over baseline for 10m. Pager: oncall-primary.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics update (1m avg): latency +4%, error rate 0.3%, throughput stable. No rollbacks triggered.

jordan: No OOMs observed yet, but two instances showed memory spike from 70% -> 92%. Keeping an eye.

alex: If we see quality regression (internal eval delta <= -2 points) auto-fallback that region to rwdx-1.0. Who owns rolling back across regions? @jordan?

jordan: I'll coordinate rollback and the public-facing release notes if needed. I'll also prepare a rollback playbook.

maya: Drafting release notes now: "rwdx-1.1: decoding improvements and tokenization fixes; default fallback to rwdx-1.0 for regressions; session pinning enabled." Will post to #announcements after GA.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 25% global -> starting rollout. (deploy id dpl_8792)

ops-bot: Canary metrics at 25%: p50 +7%, error rate 0.9%, regen-failures 0.4%.

sri: Approve moving eu-west to 50%, keep us-west at 5% until mem profile stabilizes.

alex: Approved. After 4 hours of stable metrics we can promote to 100%. Reminder: update the model catalog entry with compatibility notes and explicit pin guidance for long-lived sessions.

maya: Done — draft saved: https://doc.internal/redwood/releases/rwdx-1.1 (will update after GA).

alex: Final operational note: Make sure the fallback ordering is enforced by routing policy (model-variant-priority), not just documentation. Pinned sessions must never be auto-migrated by the smart router.

deploy-bot: Canary complete. Rollout to 100% scheduled for 2026-04-10T06:30:00Z unless a rollback is triggered. (deploy id dpl_8792)

jordan: I'll leave a short rollback/postmortem template in the release thread in case we need it.

alex: Great work everyone — closing this coordination thread. Will reopen if anomalies appear.
